articles.title: Gus Lamont’s parents make emotional plea as $1m reward offered for information about disappearance
articles.description:
No trace of Gus has been found since he went missing from his family’s South Australian farm on 27 September last year

The parents of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont have made an emotional plea for any information about their “unique little boy” as authorities offered a $1m reward over the disappearance.

No trace of Gus has been found since he went missing from his family’s enormous sheep farm in the South Australian outback almost a year ago.

articles.title: Suspect in ‘Putney pusher’ case was found dead after missing family meal, inquest hears
articles.description:
Brother-in-law went to check on Nicholas Brandram at his home and found him unresponsive, coroner says

The man who was arrested on suspicion of being the so-called “Putney pusher” was found dead at his home after missing a family meal, an inquest has heard.

Nicholas Brandram, 44, was arrested in June in connection with an incident on Putney Bridge on 5 May 2017 in which a jogger shoved a woman headfirst into the path of an oncoming bus.

articles.title: Rwandan man charged with crimes linked to 1994 genocide in first case brought in UK
articles.description:
Dr Vincent Brown will appear at Westminster magistrates court charged with seven offences

A man has been charged with crimes linked to the genocide in Rwanda in 1994 in the first case of its kind to be brought in the UK.

Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, who used to live in Kigali, the capital of Rwanda but now lives in Islington, north London, will appear at Westminster magistrates court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.
